Description: Evaluates the connectivity and latency across all core infrastructure components: - **PostgreSQL Database**: Executes a lightweight verification query (`SELECT 1`). - **Redis Cache & Queue**: Verifies connectivity via the ARQ Redis connection pool. - **MinIO Object Storage**: Performs a bucket listing check to verify S3 storage accessibility. - **Label Studio**: Tests HTTP connectivity against the configured Label Studio server endpoint.  Returns an aggregated status summary (`healthy`, `degraded`, or `unhealthy`) alongside detailed per-component metrics.
Responses: HTTP 200: System health evaluation completed | HTTP 500: Internal server error occurred during health inspection

Description: Retrieves a paginated list of student records from PostgreSQL. Supports offset pagination via `skip` and `limit` query parameters.
Parameters: skip (query, integer, Optional); limit (query, integer, Optional)
Responses: HTTP 200: List of students retrieved successfully | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Persists a new student record into the PostgreSQL database.  - **name**: Full student name (required, 2-100 characters). - **age**: Student age in years (optional, 1-120). - **major**: Academic major / department (optional).
Responses: HTTP 201: Student created successfully | HTTP 400: Validation error or invalid input payload | HTTP 500: Database persistence failure | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Retrieves the complete profile of a single student using their unique integer ID. Returns `404 Not Found` if no student exists with the provided ID.
Responses: HTTP 200: Student record found | HTTP 404: Student record not found | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Modifies one or more attributes of an existing student record in PostgreSQL. Only fields included in the request body will be updated.
Responses: HTTP 200: Student record updated successfully | HTTP 404: Student not found for update | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Deletes a student record permanently from the PostgreSQL database.
Responses: HTTP 200: Student record deleted successfully | HTTP 404: Student not found for deletion | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Lists all accessible buckets in the MinIO instance along with their creation timestamps and versioning status.
Responses: HTTP 200: Buckets retrieved successfully | HTTP 500: S3 connection error

Description: Enables or suspends S3 object versioning for the specified MinIO bucket. When versioning is enabled, modifying or re-uploading an object creates a new version ID rather than overwriting existing data.
Parameters: bucket_name (path, string, Required); enable (query, boolean, Optional)
Responses: HTTP 200: Bucket versioning configuration updated successfully | HTTP 500: MinIO error setting versioning | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Uploads a binary file stream into MinIO S3 storage.  - **file**: Multipart file payload. - **object_name**: Custom destination path inside bucket (optional, defaults to original filename). - **bucket_name**: Target MinIO bucket (optional, defaults to configured `my-photos` bucket).  If bucket versioning is enabled, MinIO automatically attaches a unique `version_id` to the response.
Responses: HTTP 201: File uploaded successfully | HTTP 400: Invalid file or empty payload | HTTP 500: MinIO upload failure | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Retrieves the list of objects stored inside a MinIO bucket. Supports filtering by object prefix (e.g. `datasets/images/`).
Parameters: bucket_name (query, any, Optional); prefix (query, string, Optional)
Responses: HTTP 200: Objects listed successfully | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Retrieves all historical version revisions for a given object key in MinIO. Allows inspecting all previous revisions, their sizes, timestamps, and current active status.
Parameters: object_name (path, string, Required); bucket_name (query, any, Optional)
Responses: HTTP 200: Version history retrieved | HTTP 404: Object not found | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Streams an object's binary content directly from MinIO to the HTTP client. Supports downloading a specific historical revision by supplying the `version_id` query parameter. If `version_id` is omitted, the latest version is returned.
Parameters: object_name (path, string, Required); bucket_name (query, any, Optional); version_id (query, any, Optional)
Responses: HTTP 200: File stream returned successfully | HTTP 404: Object or specified version ID not found | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Deletes an object or a specific version ID from MinIO. If `version_id` is specified, only that particular historical revision is deleted.
Parameters: object_name (path, string, Required); bucket_name (query, any, Optional); version_id (query, any, Optional)
Responses: HTTP 200: Object deleted successfully | HTTP 500: MinIO deletion error | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Submits a computational task into the Redis-backed ARQ message queue for asynchronous processing by worker processes.  - **job_name**: The registered python function name to run in the background (default: `simple_work`). - **args**: Positional arguments list to pass to the worker. - **kwargs**: Keyword arguments dictionary to pass to the worker.  Returns immediately with an assigned `job_id` and initial `queued` state.
Responses: HTTP 202: Job placed on queue successfully | HTTP 500: Redis connection or queue submission failure | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Queries the real-time execution state of a previously dispatched background task. Possible status values: - `queued`: Waiting in queue for an available worker thread. - `in_progress`: Currently executing in worker process. - `complete`: Finished execution; `result` contains worker return value. - `not_found`: Job expired from Redis or does not exist.
Responses: HTTP 200: Job status retrieved successfully | HTTP 500: Redis inspection error | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Fetches all existing labeling projects configured in Label Studio. Returns project metadata including total task count and completed annotation statistics.
Responses: HTTP 200: Projects retrieved successfully | HTTP 500: Label Studio connection error

Description: Retrieves all annotation tasks associated with a specific project ID in Label Studio. Each task contains the payload (e.g. image URLs or text) and any completed annotation labels.
Responses: HTTP 200: Project tasks retrieved successfully | HTTP 404: Project ID not found | HTTP 500: Label Studio error | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Submits a new data item (e.g. S3 image URL or dataset sample) into Label Studio for manual annotation.
Responses: HTTP 201: Task created successfully | HTTP 500: Failed to create task | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Summary: เข้าคิวสั่งเทรนโมเดล (Token Classification)
Description: รับคำสั่งเทรนโมเดล แล้ว enqueue งานเข้าคิว ARQ ชื่อ `training_queue` โดยเฉพาะ เพื่อให้ Trainer Worker (container แยกที่มี GPU) เป็นตัวเดียวที่หยิบงานนี้ไปทำ  - **dataset_object_name**: ชื่อไฟล์ dataset ที่ต้องอัปโหลดเข้า MinIO ไว้ล่วงหน้าแล้ว - **model_output_name**: ชื่อโมเดลที่จะใช้บันทึกกลับไป MinIO เมื่อเทรนเสร็จ - **queue_time**: ถ้าระบุ งานจะไม่เริ่มจนกว่าจะถึงเวลานี้ (ใช้ ARQ `_defer_until` เบื้องหลัง)
Responses: HTTP 202: เข้าคิวสำเร็จ | HTTP 500: เข้าคิวไม่สำเร็จ (Redis connection error) | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Summary: ตรวจสอบสถานะงานเทรน
Description: ตรวจสอบว่างานเทรนที่ enqueue ไว้อยู่ในสถานะใด (queued / in_progress / complete)
Responses: HTTP 200: Successful Response | HTTP 422: Validation Error

Description: Returns high-level metadata, version information, and quick links to interactive documentation.
Responses: HTTP 200: Successful Response
